raw_text: Follow `RULES.md` strictly. Read every file you modify in full before editing it. Never use `--no-verify`. Never commit unless the user explicitly asks. Do not open PRs unless the user explicitly asked. Do not merge or close anything unless the user explicitly asked. If a conflict appears in untouched files, stop and ask the user. `git add <specific-file-paths>` `git pull --rebase` `git reset --hard` `git clean -fd` `git commit --no-verify`
